concerns.text: T104 requires the convergence monitor to flag iterations with 'tolerance < 1e-4', but the convergence-log record schema defined in T101 is [{iteration_id, sample_size, converged, max_iterations, error_message}] — no tolerance field exists. The specified check can never fire on the log T101 produces, making T104's contract test (one flagged iteration via tolerance) unexecutable as written. Either add a tolerance field to T101's log schema or drop the tolerance check from T104.

T105 is too coarse for deterministic execution: one task covers executing multi_paradigm_runner over 5 datasets × 2 grids × 2 kernels × 5 effect sizes × ≥50 iterations × 3 alphas × 3 tolerances AND producing 6 distinct output classes (power-curve CSVs, predictor_correlation.csv, logistic_models/, sensitivity_metrics.json, timing_breakdown.csv, success_criteria_status.json). Split into per-output or per-stage tasks (execution, aggregation, validation) so each has a single verifiable deliverable.

T103 asserts data/derived/processed_roi/roi_timeseries.csv exists, but the data model specifies {dataset_id}_{kernel}.csv in that directory. The implementer cannot tell which filename the pipeline actually writes; T103's assertion may fail against a conforming implementation. State the exact expected filename (and reconcile with the data model).

T103's command references test_config.yaml but no task creates or locates this file, and quickstart.md is not in the reviewed artifacts. Add the config file's path/contents (dataset, N=10, kernel 4 s, Motor paradigm) or name the task that produces it, so the command is runnable.
